title: Helling's theorem: the maximal subgroups of SL₂(ℝ) commensurable with SL₂(ℤ)
summary: Formal statements and proofs, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, of Helling's theorem and of consequences for normalizers. A subgroup G ≤ SL₂(ℝ) is commensurable with SL₂(ℤ) if G ∩ SL₂(ℤ) has finite index in G and in SL₂(ℤ); Γ₀(N)⁺ is the group generated by the Atkin–Lehner elements of level N, and contains Γ₀(N). Every G commensurable with SL₂(ℤ) is conjugate into Γ₀(N)⁺ for some squarefree N, by (det A)^{−1/2}·A for an integral matrix A with det A > 0.
